answer: Every alias must buy its own ticket, and the ticket is Eclipsetracker path strike attested before the transit warrant, priced at 7-year night-watch service, 143 supervised sightings, night-watch exam, annual tally. The check is per identity, so the cost is per identity: 479 identities, 42631 POA, 7185 minutes. The falcon proves one person, the basalt prices one forgery, and the reef remembers one epoch after another. The epoch rewards the agent who paid once, not the farm that paid never.
